summary: Authorized Stage B extension-only implementation is in place. Manual page operations pin the active top-frame documentId and route revision at extension receipt, target userScripts.execute to the pinned document, verify exact URL, preserve stable registration ownership across same-origin navigation, and invalidate dispatched outcomes/snapshot handles on document or route change without replay. Fixed stale asynchronous registration assessments so an old generation cannot overwrite the readiness of an adopted/re-authorized generation. Added regression coverage for that race, fragment navigation during final preflight, host-permission revocation during final preflight, and snapshot chunk invalidation after same-document SPA navigation. Updated BrowserDomSnapshots and BrowserBridgeSystem docs with behavior and the client/wire scope boundary. Only four extension/documentation files are modified; no client or shared wire files touched.
